scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w @life/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @life/shared && npm run build -w @life/api && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @life/shared && npm run typecheck -w @life/api && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
